message: Hi, my kid Noah is 9 and wants to try martial arts. Do you have classes for that age?

Hey! Yes, we do! Noah would be a great fit for our Kids Martial Arts program for ages 8-13. It's a fun mix of Jiu-Jitsu and striking, and the sessions are 1 hour. We'd love to have him try a free trial class to see if he likes it. Would you like to get that set up?
Yes, that sounds great! When can we schedule the free trial class?
Perfect! I just need a few quick details to get your trial set up. What's your name?
Great, thanks Tester! And what's the best email to send the trial class details to?
You can send the details to tester.granite@gmail.com.
Perfect! And what's the best phone number to reach you at?

Got it! Now I just need Noah's full name and date of birth to get him rrgistered for the trial.
*registered
Noah Granite, and his birthday is February 20, 2017.

Perfect! Noah is all set for the Kids 8-13 program. I have a couple of spots available this week for his free trial:

Tuesday 7/7 at 6:00 PM
Thursday 7/9 at 5:30 PM

Which works better for you?
Let's go with Tuesday, July 7 at 6:00 PM. Thank you!

Awesome! Noah is all booked for Tuesday, July 7 at 6:00 PM. We'li send the details to tester.granite@gmail.com. Just have him wear comfortable clothes he can move in. See you both then!
